description: LumenOS compiler toolchain version pinning. Source of truth for reproducible builds.

primary.name: LLVM/Clang + LLD
primary.rationale: Modern, actively maintained, excellent Rust support, consistent across platforms, good x86-64 support.

llvm.reason: Latest stable with mature C23/C++23 support and stable LTO

lld.reason: LLVM linker, part of LLVM 18 release

nasm.reason: Assembler for x86-64 boot code and critical sections

rust.reason: Userspace utilities and potential future kernel components. Toolchain: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

qemu.reason: System emulation for testing. Needs: qemu-system-x86_64

gdb.reason: Debugging kernel via QEMU. Optional but recommended.

update_frequency: Quarterly (or when critical fixes are needed)

policy.lts_support: Maintain N and N-1 major versions if needed
policy.breaking_changes: Documented in CHANGELOG.md before merge to main
